content.short: Third Academy offers Web3 courses and a library of education articles.
content.description: Third Academy is a Web3 education platform and career launchpad designed to onboard professionals into the Web3 field through structured, cohort-based learning. It collaborates with experts in the field to cover a broad range of Web3 topics, and members can participate as co-builders, mentors, or contributors, earning on-chain accreditation for their progression. Presently, the academy offers courses in Web3 Marketing and Metaverse foundations, equipping learners with practical skills and pathways toward real-world Web3 roles.
